visual.name: P6WBSMatrix
visual.description: Primavera P6 ragged WBS matrix with engine-calculated values, level bands, virtualised rows and native row selections.

dataRoles.name: WBSLevels
dataRoles.description: Bind WBS levels in order, from project to deepest WBS. Blank levels end or bridge the displayed path.

dataRoles.name: Activity
dataRoles.description: Optional activity ID. Leave empty for WBS-only mode.

dataRoles.name: Values
dataRoles.description: Plain text, date and numeric measures, in column order.

dataRoles.name: Tooltips
dataRoles.description: Additional measures evaluated in each row context.
